name: rolling-text
title: Rolling Text
description: Rolls every letter up and swaps it for a copy of itself, on hover, mount or scroll into view.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and renders plain text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
